title: Bridge battery disconnects
symptom: Bridge battery warnings randomly pop up on nightly versions, causing xDrip to stop reading glucose values and requiring app restart. The warning appears even after changing the Blucon battery, sometimes within hours, despite the battery being fine as validated by voltage measurement.
cause: Possible bug in persistent storage or Blucon storing low battery info even after battery change, taking a while to correct.
fix: User can disable the collector battery alert via settings / Alarm / extra Alarms / collector battery alert. Additionally, suggestion to use a Sony battery type.
evidence_quote: settings / Alarm / extra Alarms / collector battery alert?
